problems: DECISION TO REVIEW: Cliopatria draws one realm as Dzungar Khanate 1609-1618, Oirat Confederation 1619-1676 (identical shapes) and Dzungar Khanate 1677-1756. Following the pages (Dzungar 'Established: 1634', Oirat 'Disestablished: 1634'), oirat-confederation runs 1609-1634 (start moved back from 1619 at confidence 1) and dzungar-khanate 1634-1757 with the Oirat rows of 1634-1676 as new keyframes. The kazakh-khanate ledger (1643 contest_start, 1658 contest_end and loss) names oirat-confederation as counterpart; with this split it should read dzungar-khanate. Restoring Cliopatria's partition or merging into one dossier is described in both dossiers' notes.
oirat-confederation and four-oirats share Wikidata Q4332415 but are different polities (four-oirats ends 1480; oirat-confederation starts 1609): not merged; four-oirats is named as predecessor.

Date mismatch with nogai-horde: its dossier dates the loss of the Volga-Yaik strip to the Kalmyks 1636 (Cliopatria's shape change) while kalmyk-khanate dates the matching gain 1634 (Nogai page infobox 'Conquered by the Kalmyk Khanate: 1634').

Counterpart slugs without a dossier give validator warnings: yarkent-khanate (dzungar-khanate), tashkent-state and kara-kyrgyz-khanate (khanate-of-kokand). emirate-of-bukhara, khanate-of-bukhara, kazakh-khanate, khoshut-khanate, nogai-horde, safavid-dynasty, afsharid-iran, qing-dynasty, russian-empire and ottoman-empire are used as counterparts; the matching gains and losses should be checked in those dossiers.
